start.speaker: Sister Odile
start.text: Softly. The nave repeats things. I am a lector, or I was, and I am carrying a line that was struck out of every copy in the library. Are you going up? I can walk. I have been telling myself that for a while now.

choices.text: I am going down, not up.

taken.speaker: Sister Odile
taken.text: Then I will keep up, and if I do not keep up you will not stop. Say it. — Good. That is the arrangement everybody else lied about.

left.speaker: Sister Odile
left.text: Down. Of course down. Go on, then — I will keep this landing warm, which is a joke, and it is the last one I have.

already.speaker: An empty landing
already.text: Somebody sat here long enough to wear the stone smooth. Whoever it was is not sitting here now.
